name: nellore-diwali-dhamaka
description: Nellore Diwali Dhamaka — festival ticket booking, rewards, referral and lucky draw platform.

scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --project demo-ndd --only firestore,storage "vitest run --config vitest.rules.config.ts"
scripts.test:functions: npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-ndd --only auth,firestore,functions,storage "vitest run --config vitest.integration.config.ts"
scripts.test:all: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm --prefix functions test && npm run test:rules && npm run test:functions
scripts.emulators: npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:start --project demo-ndd
scripts.deploy:staging: npm run build:staging && firebase deploy --project staging
scripts.deploy:prod: npm run build:prod && firebase deploy --project prod
